full_prompt_en: A square devotional icon painting presents a bearded haloed man from the waist up inside a richly carved brown and gold frame. The background within the inner arch is warm ochre with an aged, finely patterned surface, while the outer border is packed with curling floral relief in deep umber, muted red, and touches of blue-green. At the center, the man faces forward with a still, direct gaze; his long brown hair parts in the middle and falls to either side of a narrow face, above a full tapered beard. A pale circular halo surrounds his head, marked by faint linear divisions and small indistinct characters. The shoulders and torso fill the lower half of the inner panel. A rust-red robe appears across the left side of his body, and a deep teal-blue drape crosses the right shoulder and gathers in long soft folds below. His raised right hand sits near the middle left in a gesture of blessing, its fingers separated and clearly outlined. His other hand supports an open pale book at the lower right. Lines of writing are visible on the pages, though too small and softened to transcribe reliably. Two small birds perch within the arch at either side of his shoulders, adding balanced blue, cream, and rusty accents against the gold ground. The arched inner border and rectangular outer frame repeat around the figure, creating a nested, nearly symmetrical arrangement. The paint appears matte and slightly worn, with fine dark outlines guiding the facial features, folds, feather shapes, and ornate frame. Warm even light glows across the gold field and face, while deeper brown shadows settle into the carved border and clothing folds. The whole composition feels intimate and solemn, its centered stillness intensified by jewel-toned drapery and dense gilded ornament.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形宗教圣像画把一位蓄须、带光环的男子半身置于繁复雕饰的棕金色画框中。内拱中的背景是暖赭黄色，表面带有陈旧而细密的纹样；外边框则挤满深棕、柔红和少许蓝绿色的卷曲花卉浮雕。中央男子正面凝视，神情安静而直接；棕色长发中分，沿窄长脸庞两侧下垂，下方是饱满而渐尖的胡须。淡色圆形光环围绕头部，带隐约的分隔线和无法辨清的小字。肩部与躯干占据内画面的下半部。锈红色长袍出现在身体左侧，深青蓝色披布越过右肩，向下聚成柔软的长褶。他抬起的右手位于中间偏左，作祝福姿势，手指分开且轮廓清楚。另一只手在右下方托着一本打开的浅色书。书页上可见文字线条，但过小又柔化，无法可靠誊录。两只小鸟分别栖在肩膀两侧的拱内，在金色背景前加入对称的蓝、奶油白和锈色强调。内层拱框与矩形外框围绕人物一再重复，构成嵌套、近乎对称的布局。颜料显得哑光而略经磨损，精细深线引导五官、衣褶、羽毛形状和华丽边框。暖而均匀的光映亮金色底和面容，较深棕影沉在雕花边框和衣褶里。整幅构图亲密而肃穆，珠宝色披衣与密集的镀金装饰进一步凸显中央人物的静止感。
style_prompt_en: A matte icon-painting treatment combines a warm metallic-looking ground with dense ornamental relief and jewel-toned flat color. Fine dark outlines describe features and fold direction, while softly modeled highlights give forms restrained volume without breaking the frontal stillness. Burnished ochre, umber, rust red, and deep teal remain tightly balanced; the cool hue gains force through its limited placement against the dominant warmth. A nested arch and rectangular border gather intricate curling marks around a comparatively calm center. Worn grain and tiny irregularities make the golden field feel aged, and compact shadows deepen the recesses of the decoration. Light is broad and even rather than directional, allowing line, color area, and patterned density to establish the hierarchy. The overall visual effect is solemn, intimate, and richly worked.
style_prompt_zh: 哑光的圣像绘画效果把带金属光感的暖色底、密集装饰浮雕和珠宝色平涂结合起来。细深线勾勒形态与褶皱方向，柔和塑形的高光让形体略有体积，却不破坏正面的静止感。磨亮的赭黄、深棕、锈红和深青蓝保持紧密平衡；冷色只占有限区域，因而在主导的暖色中更有力量。层套的拱形与矩形边框将繁复卷曲痕迹聚在相对平静的中央周围。磨损颗粒与细小不规则处让金色区域显得古旧，紧凑阴影加深装饰凹处。光线宽广而均匀，并非强烈定向，视觉层级主要由线条、色块和纹样密度建立。整体效果肃穆、亲密且工艺繁富。
theme_en: A devotional icon of a haloed figure with an open book
theme_zh: 手持展开书卷的光环人物圣像
name: Orthodox icon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
